title: Falcons have spent plenty on core players this year

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Falcons have spent plenty on core players this year
sources.description: With the new contract for running back Bijan Robinson, the Falcons have recently given big deals to four young players who have become part of the nucleus of the team.
